name: POKER BULL
description: Poker Bull is an Indian Poker variant in which each player is dealt one card and holds it to their forehead without looking, so others can see it. Players ante and bet in a round of poker; highest card at showdown wins the pot (ties split). In the bull variant, highest and lowest cards share the pot.

content.text: Poker Bull is an Indian Poker variant in which each player is dealt one card and holds it to their forehead without looking, so others can see it. Players ante and bet in a round of poker; highest card at showdown wins the pot (ties split). In the bull variant, highest and lowest cards share the pot.

Indian Poker is named after the idea that cards held to the players' heads resemble a Native American headdress or war bonnet; it has nothing to do with India. It is also known as Blind Man's Buff. The basic one-card version is described as presumably the original: players ante, receive one card each face down, hold it to the forehead without looking so others can see it, then a round of poker betting follows; at showdown the highest card wins (or in the bull variant, the highest and lowest cards share the pot).
